data_dir.description: Main data directory where backup metadata and temporary files are stored.

cache_dir.description: Directory used for caching chunks and index data to improve performance.

log_file.description: Path to the primary log file. Rotated automatically by the daemon.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error. Use 'debug' only for troubleshooting.

node_id.description: Unique identifier for this node in the cluster (e.g., a UUID). Auto-generated if empty.

node_name.description: Human-readable name for this node (used in logs and UI).

cluster_name.description: Name of the backup cluster; all nodes in the same cluster coordinate deduplication.

backends.description: List of storage backends where backup data is persisted. At least one must be enabled.

enabled.description: Whether this backend is active. Disabled backends are ignored.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g., 'https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com'). Only for S3.

region.description: AWS region (or equivalent) for S3. Only for S3.

bucket.description: S3 bucket name. Required for S3.

access_key.description: S3 access key ID. Can be a path to a file (e.g., 'file:/etc/keys/s3.key') for secrets.

secret_key.description: S3 secret access key. Use same pattern as access_key for security.

path.description: Local or remote path (for local/ssh backends). For SSH, must be absolute.

host.description: SSH hostname or IP. Required for SSH backend.

port.description: SSH port (typically 22). Only for SSH backend.

user.description: SSH username for remote storage. Only for SSH backend.

key_file.description: Path to the SSH private key file (PEM format). Required for SSH backend.

compression.description: Enable transparent compression before sending to backend.

encryption.description: Enable client-side encryption (AES-256-GCM). Data is unreadable by the backend.

schedules.description: Backup job definitions. Each schedule runs at its own interval/cron.

name.description: Unique schedule name (used in logs and status).

enabled.description: Enable or disable this backup schedule.

policy.description: Backup policy: full (all files), incremental (changed since last backup), differential (changed since last full).

source_dirs.description: List of directories to back up (must exist or be accessible).

retention.description: How many backups of each type to keep. Older backups beyond limits are auto-deleted.

keep_daily.description: Keep at least this many daily snapshots.

keep_weekly.description: Keep at least this many weekly snapshots.

keep_monthly.description: Keep at least this many monthly snapshots.

cron.description: Cron expression (UTC). If present, interval_seconds is ignored.

interval_seconds.description: Interval (in seconds) between runs. Only used if cron is not set.

workers.max_concurrent_backups.description: Maximum number of backups running in parallel (globally).

workers.max_upload_workers_per_backend.description: Upload workers per backend. Higher = more parallel uploads, more memory.

workers.chunk_size_mb.description: Chunk size (in MiB) for deduplication. Larger = fewer chunks but less deduplication granularity.

workers.cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long chunk metadata stays in memory cache (0 = no caching).

workers.mem_limit_mb.description: Maximum memory (MiB) the daemon may use. Exceeding triggers graceful throttling.

network.connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for establishing connection to backends.

network.retry_max_attempts.description: Max retry attempts on transient errors (e.g., network hiccup).

network.retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay (seconds) for exponential backoff between retries.

network.enable_tls.description: Enforce TLS for internal and external communications (nodes, HTTP backends).

network.ca_cert_file.description: CA cert bundle for validating TLS connections. Required if enable_tls=true.

notifications.email_enabled.description: Enable email alerts on backup events.

notifications.smtp_port.description: SMTP port (usually 587 for TLS or 465 for SSL).

notifications.recipients.description: Email addresses to receive backup alerts.

notifications.on_error.description: Send alert when a backup or sync fails.

notifications.on_success.description: Send alert after every successful backup (noise but good for auditing).

security.enable_audit_log.description: Log all access, restore, and admin actions to the audit file.

security.audit_log_file.description: Path to the audit log file (immutable if possible).

security.require_client_cert.description: Require mutual TLS for node-to-node and CLI connections.

security.allowed_client_ips.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDRs for management API and CLI access.
